Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ng-who-hiv-concepts-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-who-hiv-concepts-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
HIV.H.DE42 Lost to follow-upTwenty-eight days or more since last missed appointment
HIV.H.DE43 Transferred outThe client transferred to another facility
HIV.H.DE44 Death (documented)People living with HIV previously on ART who are confirmed to have died from any cause
HIV.D.DE45 Restarting ARTClient is restarting ART after stopping treatment for any reason
HIV.D.DE40 Stopped ARTClient stopped taking ART
HIV.H.DE45 Refused (stopped) treatmentClient was contacted and confirmed to have stopped ART (reasons may include stigma and discrimination, faith healing, etc.)
HIV.H.DE47 On ARTClient is currently taking ART
HIV.H.DE4 Did not initiate ARTClient did not initiate ART at the same time as diagnosis (e.g., because they required additional counselling) and required follow-up for ART initiation
HIV.D.DE382 ART initiated within 7 days of diagnosisClient initiated ART within 7 days of diagnosis
HIV.B.DE147 Linked to enrolment in care and ART initiationLinkage made from HIV testing to enrolment in care following an HIV diagnosis
HIV.H.DE41 HIV Treatement outcomeThe outcome for the client which is used for reporting retention/attrition.
HIV.H.DE49 Transfer confirmedSelect if transfer to another facility is confirmed
HIV.D.DE371 Patient self-reported as not ready/willingClient did not initiate ART at diagnosis or within 7 days of diagnosis because client self-reported as not ready/willing
HIV.D.DE372 Not completed education, support and preparation for ARTClient did not initiate ART at diagnosis or within 7 days of diagnosis because client had not completed education, support and preparation for ART
HIV.D.DE377 Patient diagnosed with cryptococcal meningitisClient did not initiate ART at diagnosis or within 7 days of diagnosis because client diagnosed with cryptococcal meningitis
HIV.D.DE378 Patient diagnosed with histoplasmosisClient did not initiate ART at diagnosis or within 7 days of diagnosis because client diagnosed with histoplasmosis
HIV.D.DE380 OtherClient did not initiate ART at diagnosis or within 7 days of diagnosis because of other reason
HIV.B.DE51 Sex workerClient is a sex worker
HIV.B.DE52 Men who have sex with menClient is a man who has sex with men
HIV.B.DE53 Trans and gender-diverse peopleClient identifies as trans and gender-diverse
HIV.B.DE54 People who inject drugsClient is a person who injects drugs
HIV.B.DE58 Orphan or vulnerable childClient considered an orphan or vulnerable child
HIV.D.DE250 Provide isoniazid preventive therapyProvide isoniazid preventive therapy
HIV.D.DE496 Enhanced adherence counselling providedEnhanced adherence counselling was provided to the client during the visit
HIV.D.DE223 Other reason for stopping ARTClient stopped ART because of other reason
HIV.D.DE425 Treatment failureART treatment failure
HIV.D.DE434 OtherA switch was made to the regimen for another reason
HIV.D.DE215 Other reason for nonadherenceClient reported not being adherent because of other reason for nonadherence
HIV.B.DE84 Nucleic acid test for HIVVirological test, which includes testing for early infant diagnosis
HIV.D.DE406 HIV viral load test orderedProvider ordered an HIV viral load test
HIV.D.DE364 CD4 countCD4 cell count in cells/mm^3
HIV.D.DE365 CD4 cell percentageCD4 cell percentage

name: NgWhoHivConceptsCS
title: Nigeria Local WHO HIV Concepts
description: Local Nigeria CodeSystem containing the subset of WHO SMART HIV concept codes used by the Nigeria HIV terminology mappings. Code values are preserved exactly from the supplied WHO HIV concept list. Full concepts can be found here: https://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem-HIVConcepts.htmlhttps://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem-HIVConcepts.html
